name: A Tale About Flowers
source:
A Tale About Flowers is a short visual novel located in a cyberpunk city where you play as Canaan, a young investigator. As you investigate a murder you uncover some secrets you shouldn't have. What will be your fate?

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1875980/A_Tale_About_Flowers/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《花的故事》是一部短篇视觉小说，故事发生在一个赛博朋克城市，你扮演的是一位年轻的调查员迦南。当你调查一桩谋杀案时，你发现了一些不该知道的秘密。你的命运会怎样？

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1875980/A_Tale_About_Flowers/]Steam[/url]]
